objective: signed_forward_displacement_m / completed_duration_s, subject to all runtime gates
comparison: Identical preparation, physics profile, initial baseline, horizon, seed pairing, gates and reserved simulation budget. Report actual simulated seconds, rejected/failed attempts, proposal+preparation+simulation+storage wall cost, and incumbent improvement versus cumulative wall hours. Alternate algorithms; single host thread.

finalist_validation.scope: Explicit sensitivity assumptions, not measured confidence intervals or guaranteed hardware envelope. Save modifications separately from CAD.

remaining: Finish shared comparison host and outcome gates
Prepare/screen baseline and parameter coverage cases
Requalify reduced profile with current library source
Run both optimizers through full matched budgets

failure_handling.bayesian: After initial LHS, if fewer than dimension+1 successful observations exist, sample within 5% of each full parameter range around the best valid point until the objective GP can fit. Label these proposals as local feasibility bootstrap; never invent speed observations for failures.
failure_handling.cma_es: Failures rank below every finite accepted speed. Restart deterministically from the original mean/spread if the backend terminates; preserve and replay all attempts.

search_domain: Full relative phase interval [0,0.999] for each of three feet; first foot fixes common phase. Stance fraction [0.60,0.90] permits both paired and staggered support schedules. Current pause-based controller still requires a feasible all-stance stopping window. Domain finalized before optimizer trials; baseline unchanged.
